63:

118: 
119: - **Outcome:** Browser/MCP mutations emit the same DAV changes as Apple mutations.

121: - **Scope:** Base event create/update/delete paths and transactional revisions.

123: - **Out of scope:** Moves, occurrences, imported feeds, sync response.

130: - **Outcome:** Apple receives only changes after its opaque token, including deletions.

140: 
141: - **Outcome:** No supported Happening mutation bypasses DAV sync.
142: - **Depends on:** T11.
143: - **Scope:** Moves, occurrence changes, supported external/imported paths, source-delete/target-create.

150: ## T13 — All-day semantics
151: 
152: - **Outcome:** All-day events round-trip without date shifts or conversion to timed events.

154: - **Scope:** DATE DTSTART/DTEND, exclusive end, timezone-independent mapping.

156: - **Out of scope:** Recurrence and floating timed events.

160: 
161: ## T14 — Recurrence semantics
162: 
163: - **Outcome:** Series and modified/deleted occurrences round-trip as one canonical resource.

165: - **Scope:** Supported RRULE, RECURRENCE-ID, EXDATE, master ETag/mutation mapping.

173: 
174: - **Outcome:** DAV matches Happening permissions and never makes imported content writable.

176: - **Scope:** Owner/editor/viewer/free-busy, revocation, imported resources, path ownership.

178: - **Out of scope:** New roles/sharing UI.
179: - **Acceptance:** Roles pass the access matrix; revocation is immediate; foreign existence is hidden; imported writes fail.
180: - **Verify:** Table-driven service/HTTP authorization tests.
181: - **Handoff:** Supply matrix and denial codes to T18/T19.

183: ## T16 — Safe client-property preservation
184: 
185: - **Outcome:** Apple edits preserve approved client-owned metadata.
186: - **Depends on:** T14.
187: - **Scope:** Allowlisted alarms, categories, URL, transparency, selected X-properties.
188: - **Changes:** Parse, validate, persist, merge, serialize allowlist; reject scheduling/unsupported components.

192: - **Handoff:** Freeze allowlist/examples for docs.

195: 
196: - **Outcome:** Users safely set up, inspect, revoke, and disconnect devices.

198: - **Scope:** Disconnected, one-time secret, connected, attention, revoke-one, disconnect-all states.

200: - **Out of scope:** Configuration profiles and Apple credentials.

202: - **Verify:** Frontend tests and Playwright lifecycle with immediate DAV failure after revoke.
203: - **Handoff:** T18/T19 reuse setup/error language.
204: 
205: ## T18 — Production hardening
206: 
207: - **Outcome:** DAV fails safely under malformed, oversized, brute-force, or insecure traffic.
208: - **Depends on:** T11, T15, T17.
209: - **Scope:** Parser/body/report limits, DAV rate limits, redacted logs, metrics, HTTPS/proxy validation.
210: - **Changes:** Add bounded middleware/parsers, safe telemetry, and fail-closed production transport checks.
211: - **Out of scope:** General observability redesign.
212: - **Acceptance:** Violations fail before writes; auth throttling is independent; logs contain no credentials/bodies; insecure production config fails closed.
213: - **Verify:** Adversarial suite, redaction/rate tests, production-config smoke test.
214: - **Handoff:** Provide operator checklist and sanitized diagnostics.
215: 
216: ## T19 — Apple compatibility, cleanup, and docs
217: 
218: - **Outcome:** Current macOS/iOS Calendar completes connect, sync, CRUD, and revoke.
219: - **Depends on:** T12, T14, T16, T18.
220: - **Scope:** Real-client acceptance, sanitized fixtures, legacy fake-CalDAV/WebCal cleanup, deployment/user docs.
221: - **Changes:** Test Apple clients; encode protocol differences as regressions; remove misleading scaffold while retaining explicit one-off ICS export.
222: - **Out of scope:** Apple credentials, Apple-side calendar creation/deletion, scheduling, tasks/journals, configuration profiles.
223: - **Acceptance:** Both clients connect; initial/incremental sync and supported CRUD work; revoke fails next request; UI/docs match reality.
224: - **Verify:** Signed device checklist, full DAV/frontend/backend suites, deployment smoke test.
225: - **Handoff:** Release only after this passes; record supported OS versions/limits.
226: 
227: ## Gate 4 summary
228: 
229: - 19 packets: 2 complete, 17 awaiting approval.
230: - 14 waves with limited safe parallelism.
231: - Highest-risk packet: T14 recurrence semantics.
232: - Release boundary: T19; earlier packets are integration checkpoints.

(End of file - total 232 lines)

638: /// Conditional `PUT` that updates one existing supported timed, non-recurring
639: /// event through the domain service.
640: ///
641: /// Requires `If-Match` carrying the current ETag. Fails with 412 when the
642: /// precondition is missing or stale, without mutating the event. On success
643: /// the update is applied atomically against the observed version and the
644: /// ETag rotates to reflect the new canonical content.
645: async fn handle_put_update_event_resource(
646:     accounts: &CaldavAccountService,
647:     session: &DavSession,
648:     _principal_id: &str,
649:     calendar: &CaldavCalendar,
650:     resource: &CaldavEventResource,
651:     request: Request,
652: ) -> Response {
653:     let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(&calendar.role) else {
654:         return dav_server_error();
655:     };
656:     if authorize_calendar_action(
657:         UserStatus::Active,
658:         Some(PlatformRole::User),
659:         Some(role),
660:         CalendarAction::EditAnyEvent,
661:     ) != AuthorizationDecision::Allow
662:     {
663:         return dav_resource_not_found();
664:     }
665: 
666:     let if_match = request
667:         .headers()
668:         .get(header::IF_MATCH)
669:         .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok());
670:     let Some(if_match) = if_match else {
671:         return (
672:             StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED,
673:             "If-Match is required to update a resource",
674:         )
675:             .into_response();
676:     };
677: 
678:     let event = match EventRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone())
679:         .event(calendar.calendar_id, resource.event_id)
680:         .await
681:     {
682:         Ok(Some(event)) => event,
683:         Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
684:         Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
685:     };
686:     let Some((_, current_etag)) = ical_and_etag(resource, &event) else {
687:         return dav_resource_not_found();
688:     };
689:     if !etag_matches(if_match, &current_etag) {
690:         return (StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED, "precondition failed").into_response();
691:     }
692: 
693:     let body = match axum::body::to_bytes(request.into_body(), query::MAX_BODY_BYTES).await {
694:         Ok(body) => body,
695:         Err(_) => return dav_bad_request("request body too large"),
696:     };
697:     let body_str = match std::str::from_utf8(&body) {
698:         Ok(value) => value,
699:         Err(_) => return dav_bad_request("request body must be UTF-8"),
700:     };
701:     let parsed = match parse_calendar(body_str, IcsParserLimits::default()) {
702:         Ok(parsed) => parsed,
703:         Err(_) => return dav_bad_request("invalid calendar data"),
704:     };
705:     if parsed.events.len() != 1 {
706:         return dav_bad_request("exactly one VEVENT is required");
707:     }
708:     let incoming = &parsed.events[0];
709:     if incoming.rrule.is_some() || incoming.recurrence_id.is_some() {
710:         return dav_bad_request("recurring events are not supported");
711:     }
712:     let timing = match &incoming.timing {
713:         crate::ics::NormalizedTiming::Timed {
714:             starts_at,
715:             ends_at,
716:             timezone,
717:         } => EventTiming::Timed {
718:             start_utc: starts_at.timestamp(),
719:             end_utc: ends_at.timestamp(),
720:             timezone: timezone.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "UTC".to_owned()),
721:         },
722:         _ => return dav_bad_request("only timed events are supported"),
723:     };
724:     if let EventTiming::Timed {
725:         start_utc, end_utc, ..
726:     } = &timing
727:         && start_utc >= end_utc
728:     {
729:         return dav_bad_request("event end must be after start");
730:     }
731:     let status = match incoming.status.as_deref() {
732:         Some("TENTATIVE") => EventStatus::Tentative,
733:         Some("CANCELLED") => EventStatus::Cancelled,
734:         _ => EventStatus::Confirmed,
735:     };
736:     if incoming.summary.trim().is_empty() {
737:         return dav_bad_request("SUMMARY is required");
738:     }
739: 
740:     let mutation = EventMutation {
741:         title: incoming.summary.clone(),
742:         description: incoming.description.clone(),
743:         location: incoming.location.clone(),
744:         status,
745:         timing,
746:     };
747:     let event_service = EventService::new_at(accounts.pool().clone(), accounts.now());
748:     let projection = match event_service
749:         .update(
750:             session.user_id,
751:             false,
752:             calendar.calendar_id,
753:             resource.event_id,
754:             EventChange {
755:                 expected_version: event.version,
756:                 target_calendar_id: calendar.calendar_id,
757:                 event: mutation,
758:             },
759:         )
760:         .await
761:     {
762:         Ok(projection) => projection,
763:         Err(EventServiceError::Conflict { .. }) => {
764:             return (StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED, "precondition failed").into_response();
765:         }
766:         Err(EventServiceError::NotFound) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
767:         Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
768:     };
769: 
770:     let event_record = match EventRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone())
771:         .event(calendar.calendar_id, projection.id)
772:         .await
773:     {
774:         Ok(Some(event_record)) => event_record,
775:         _ => return dav_server_error(),
776:     };
777:     let Some((ical, etag)) = ical_and_etag(resource, &event_record) else {
778:         return dav_server_error();
779:     };
780:     (
781:         StatusCode::OK,
782:         [
783:             (header::ETAG, etag.as_str()),
784:             (header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/calendar; charset=utf-8"),
785:         ],
786:         ical,
787:     )
788:         .into_response()
789: }

791: /// True when an `If-Match` precondition is satisfied by the current ETag.
792: ///
793: /// Accepts the wildcard and a comma-separated list of strong ETags, comparing
794: /// each against the current tag.
795: fn etag_matches(if_match: &str, current_etag: &str) -> bool {
796:     let if_match = if_match.trim();

798:         return true;
799:     }
800:     if_match
801:         .split(',')
802:         .map(|tag| tag.trim())
803:         .any(|tag| tag == current_etag)
804: }

946: /// Hydrate the requested resources of one authorized collection.
947: ///
948: /// Each requested href yields exactly one `<D:response>`. Hrefs that do not
949: /// resolve to an exposed resource in this collection — including foreign
950: /// paths — return a per-item 404 so existence is never leaked.
951: async fn handle_calendar_multiget(
952:     accounts: &CaldavAccountService,
953:     principal_id: &str,
954:     calendar: &CaldavCalendar,
955:     multiget: &CalendarMultiget,
956: ) -> Response {
957:     let repository = CaldavRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
958:     let events = EventRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
959:     let mut responses = Vec::with_capacity(multiget.hrefs.len());
960:     for href in &multiget.hrefs {
961:         let resource_name = match href_within_collection(href, principal_id, calendar.calendar_id) {
962:             Some(name) => name,
963:             None => {
964:                 responses.push(multiget_response_xml(href, None));
965:                 continue;
966:             }
967:         };
968:         let resource = match repository
969:             .resolve_by_name(calendar.calendar_id, &resource_name)
970:             .await
971:         {
972:             Ok(Some(resource)) => resource,
973:             Ok(None) => {
974:                 responses.push(multiget_response_xml(href, None));
975:                 continue;
976:             }
977:             Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
978:         };
979:         let event = match events.event(calendar.calendar_id, resource.event_id).await {
980:             Ok(Some(event)) => event,
981:             Ok(None) => {
982:                 responses.push(multiget_response_xml(href, None));
983:                 continue;
984:             }
985:             Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
986:         };
987:         let recurring: bool = sqlx::query_scalar(
988:             "SELECT EXISTS(
989:                 SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE id = ? AND recurrence_rule IS NOT NULL
990:              )",
991:         )
992:         .bind(resource.event_id)
993:         .fetch_one(accounts.pool())
994:         .await
995:         .unwrap_or(false);
996:         if recurring {
997:             responses.push(multiget_response_xml(href, None));
998:             continue;
999:         }
1000:         let payload = ical_and_etag(&resource, &event).map(|(ical, etag)| (etag, ical));
1001:         responses.push(multiget_response_xml(href, payload));
1002:     }
1003:     let body = responses.join("\n");
1004:     let xml = format!(
1005:         r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
1006: <D:multistatus xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:calendarserver/">
1007: {body}
1008: </D:multistatus>"#
1009:     );
1010:     (
1011:         StatusCode::MULTI_STATUS,
1012:         [(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/xml; charset=utf-8")],
1013:         xml,
1014:     )
1015:         .into_response()
1016: }

1163:     if can_read {

1168:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write-freebusy");
1169:     }
1170:     let writable = allows(CalendarAction::CreateEvent) || allows(CalendarAction::EditAnyEvent);
1171:     if writable {
1172:         privileges.push("DAV:write-content");
1173:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write");
1174:     }
1175:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
1176:         privileges.push("DAV:write-properties");
1177:     }
1178:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageAcl) {
1179:         privileges.push("DAV:read-acl");
1180:         privileges.push("DAV:write-acl");
1181:     }

229:     pub async fn authenticate(
230:         &self,
231:         authorization: &HeaderValue,
232:     ) -> Result<DavSession, CaldavAuthError> {
233:         let (username, password) =
234:             parse_basic_authorization(authorization).ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
235:         let username = username.to_ascii_lowercase();
236:         let token = SecretToken::parse(&password).ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
237:         let token_prefix = password
238:             .chars()
239:             .take(TOKEN_PREFIX_LENGTH)
240:             .collect::<String>();
241:         let user_id: Option<i64> = sqlx::query_scalar(
242:             "SELECT id FROM users WHERE normalized_email = ? AND status = 'active'",
243:         )
244:         .bind(&username)
245:         .fetch_optional(&self.pool)
246:         .await
247:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
248:         let candidates: Vec<(i64, Vec<u8>)> = match user_id {
249:             Some(user_id) => sqlx::query_as(
250:                 "SELECT id, token_hash FROM caldav_credentials
251:                  WHERE user_id = ? AND token_prefix = ? AND revoked_at IS NULL",
252:             )
253:             .bind(user_id)
254:             .bind(&token_prefix)
255:             .fetch_all(&self.pool)
256:             .await
257:             .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?,
258:             None => Vec::new(),
259:         };
260:         let principal_id: Option<String> = match user_id {
261:             Some(user_id) => {
262:                 sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT principal_id FROM caldav_accounts WHERE user_id = ?")
263:                     .bind(user_id)
264:                     .fetch_optional(&self.pool)
265:                     .await
266:                     .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?
267:             }
268:             None => None,
269:         };
270:         let mut verified: Option<i64> = None;
271:         let mut checked_candidate = false;
272:         for (credential_id, token_hash) in &candidates {
273:             checked_candidate = true;
274:             let expected = crate::security::TokenHash::from_bytes(
275:                 token_hash
276:                     .as_slice()
277:                     .try_into()
278:                     .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?,
279:             );
280:             if self
281:                 .key
282:                 .verify_token(TokenDomain::CaldavConnection, &token, &expected)
283:             {
284:                 verified = Some(*credential_id);
285:                 break;
286:             }
287:         }
288:         if !checked_candidate {
289:             // Verify against a dummy hash so unknown-user, unknown-prefix, and
290:             // wrong-password failures take comparable time and do not reveal
291:             // which lookup failed.
292:             let dummy = crate::security::TokenHash::from_bytes([0_u8; 32]);
293:             let _ = self
294:                 .key
295:                 .verify_token(TokenDomain::CaldavConnection, &token, &dummy);
296:         }
297:         let credential_id = verified.ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
298:         let principal_id = principal_id.ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
299:         let user_id = user_id.ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
300:         let now = (self.clock)();
301:         sqlx::query(
302:             "UPDATE caldav_credentials SET last_used_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND revoked_at IS NULL",
303:         )
304:         .bind(now)
305:         .bind(credential_id)
306:         .execute(&self.pool)
307:         .await
308:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
309:         Ok(DavSession {
310:             user_id,
311:             credential_id,
312:             principal_id,
313:         })
314:     }

502: fn parse_basic_authorization(authorization: &HeaderValue) -> Option<(String, String)> {
503:     let encoded = authorization.to_str().ok()?;
504:     let (scheme, credentials) = encoded.split_once(' ')?;
505:     if !scheme.eq_ignore_ascii_case("basic") {
506:         return None;
507:     }
508:     let decoded = STANDARD.decode(credentials).ok()?;
509:     let string = String::from_utf8(decoded).ok()?;
510:     let (username, password) = string.split_once(':')?;
511:     if username.is_empty() || password.is_empty() {
512:         return None;
513:     }
514:     Some((username.to_owned(), password.to_owned()))
515: }
